set -eu
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
\echo 'diagnostic: review decision counts'
SELECT
  review_state,
  count(*)::int AS decisions
FROM governance.review_decision
WHERE tenant_key='airline-demo-new'
GROUP BY review_state
ORDER BY review_state;

\echo 'diagnostic: candidate counts awaiting review'
SELECT 'entity_candidate' AS candidate_table, count(*)::int AS candidates
FROM working.entity_candidate
WHERE tenant_key='airline-demo-new'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact_candidate' AS candidate_table, count(*)::int AS candidates
FROM working.fact_candidate
WHERE tenant_key='airline-demo-new'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'relationship_candidate' AS candidate_table, count(*)::int AS candidates
FROM working.relationship_candidate
WHERE tenant_key='airline-demo-new';
SQL
